abilities.name: Convoy Law
abilities.text: Once per round, when you reveal or accept a Contract, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.

abilities.name: Old Oaths
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a route or escort Contract, record a private convoy briefing.

abilities.name: Chain Signal
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Orenna's cleared movement and contract sectors carry a convoy briefing for the next operative.

abilities.name: Fleet Memory
abilities.text: At the start of your turn, if scenario pressure is above 0, record a private convoy briefing.
